concerns.concern: The monoclinic angle deviation (β − 90° ≈ 0.1–0.2°) is tiny. In a four-domain, pseudo-merohedrally twinned crystal measured in a DAC with box integration, it is strongly correlated with twin fractions and peak-integration choices, so it may not be reliable evidence for monoclinic symmetry.
concerns.quote: β is strongly correlated with twin fractions and peak-integration choices. This is especially true with box integration in EVAL14

concerns.concern: A lower-symmetry model always fits at least as well, so the better B2₁/a refinement compared with Bmab needs a statistical significance test that accounts for the number of refined parameters.
concerns.quote: a lower-symmetry model always fits at least as well. A statistical significance test is required, e.g. a Hamilton R-ratio test

concerns.concern: Bmab and P2₁/c differ in the tilt patterns of inner versus outer octahedra, but only one Ni–O–Ni angle is reported. A symmetry-mode decomposition showing the pressure dependence of the P2₁/c-specific distortion amplitudes is needed.
concerns.quote: A symmetry-mode decomposition (ISODISTORT/AMPLIMODES) would directly test whether P2₁/c-specific distortions are significantly nonzero near the boundary.

concerns.concern: The new Raman modes below the density-wave transition could come from zone-folded phonons of the incommensurate modulation, DW amplitude or phase modes, magnetic or spin–phonon excitations, or second-order features. Γ-point counting for a commensurate subgroup is not the right framework, so the symmetry-lowering claim should be toned down or the alternatives excluded.
concerns.quote: Since the modulation is incommensurate, Γ-point mode counting for a commensurate subgroup is not the right framework

concerns.concern: The Raman crystals contain four twin domains with a and b interchanged, so A_g/B_g selection rules should not hold within the laser spot. This undermines the per-channel mode counting and the claim that modes follow selection rules; twin domain size relative to the spot should be discussed.
concerns.quote: Within the probed spot, the "bc plane" of one domain is the "ac plane" of another, so A_g/B_g separation is not expected to hold.

concerns.concern: The Raman polarization directions are not aligned with crystal axes, so B_g modes leak into the parallel channel. The count of 31 parallel-polarization modes therefore cannot be compared with the 24 A_g limit.
concerns.quote: for φ ≠ 0 or 90°, the "yy" channel contains B_g modes.

concerns.concern: The claim of a third, lower-symmetry phase rests on only three more observed Raman modes (51) than P2₁/c allows (48), which is too narrow a margin.
concerns.quote: counting 51 modes at 26 K versus 48 allowed (24 A_g + 24 B_g) in P2₁/c, a margin of only three modes.

concerns.concern: The authors should state whether P2₁/c arises from a single irrep of I4/mmm or needs two coupled irreps. If two are needed, a direct continuous transition is non-generic in Landau theory, which bears on the central claim.
concerns.quote: If two irreps are needed, a direct continuous transition is non-generic in Landau theory.

concerns.concern: The DFT shows only order parameters vanishing in an unconstrained P2₁/c relaxation. Enthalpy differences versus pressure from constrained relaxations of I4/mmm, Fmmm, Bmab and P2₁/c are needed.
concerns.quote: Please provide constrained relaxations in each space group and plot ΔH(P).

concerns.concern: Relaxation in a single P2₁/c cell cannot detect instabilities at other wavevectors, so the claim that there is no room for intermediate structures is overstated. Phonon calculations versus pressure are requested to identify soft-mode irreps and test tetragonal stability above P_c.
concerns.quote: "no room for intermediate structures" is stronger than the calculation supports.

concerns.concern: The DFT convergence settings appear too loose for the energy scales involved: a 1 mHa energy tolerance, a coarse 2×4×4 k-mesh for a metal, and an unspecified smearing scheme. Convergence of energy differences and order parameters should be reported.
concerns.quote: The total energy is converged to 1 mHa (~27 meV per cell), which is likely much larger than the relevant energy differences.

concerns.concern: The B-centering-violating reflections are attributed to twins, so they carry no symmetry information. The authors also say their interpretation differs from Li et al., who saw the same features, without explaining how; a side-by-side discussion is needed.
concerns.quote: The authors say their interpretation "differs" from Li et al. [22], who observed the same features, but they never explain how.

concerns.concern: The (½,½,0) superlattice reflections are common to both Bmab and P2₁/c and mark only the onset of tilting. The text currently implies they evidence the monoclinic phase.
concerns.quote: Their appearance marks the onset of tilting, not monoclinicity specifically. The text should state this clearly

concerns.concern: The manuscript contradicts itself on transition order: a jump in β is attributed to a weak first-order transition, yet the transition is then called continuous.
concerns.quote: a jump in β "could be attributed to a weak first-order phase transition." A few lines later, the transition is "continuous bypassing the orthorhombic phase."

concerns.concern: The square-root scaling of β with (P_c − P) is unexpected, since shear strain coupled to a zone-boundary order parameter should scale linearly. Together with the non-monotonic β(P), this may mean β is not a clean order parameter or that a second mode is involved.
concerns.quote: Square-root scaling of β would imply a bilinear coupling that is not obvious here.

concerns.concern: The statement that superconductivity emerges only in the tetragonal phase is unsupported, since no superconductivity measurements were made and literature P_c values vary widely. At most the result is consistent with reported superconducting pressures.
concerns.quote: "This affirms that superconductivity emerges only once the system is restored to the tetragonal phase" is not supported by this work.

concerns.concern: The abstract's wording "unequivocally demonstrate" is too strong given the weaknesses in the evidence.
concerns.quote: the abstract's "unequivocally demonstrate" should be moderated given the points above.

concerns.concern: The DFT physics choices are not stated: spin polarization, +U, or magnetic order. Density-wave and magnetic correlations could shift the balance between tilt patterns.
concerns.quote: Is the calculation spin-polarized? Is any +U or magnetic order included?

concerns.concern: The absence of DW satellites in XRD needs a quantified detection limit relative to main reflections, compared with satellite intensities reported by Zhang et al.
concerns.quote: "Not detected" needs a detection limit. Please estimate an upper bound on satellite intensity relative to main reflections

concerns.concern: Oxygen stoichiometry of the crystals is not determined, though it is known to affect the density wave and structure. TGA or iodometric titration is suggested.
concerns.quote: Oxygen stoichiometry is not determined. EPMA confirms only La:Ni, and no oxygen content is reported

concerns.concern: Stacking faults and intergrowths of other Ruddlesden–Popper members, common in flux growth (with La₂NiO₄ and NiO side products present), are not addressed.
concerns.quote: Stacking faults and RP intergrowths (n = 1, 2), common in flux growth, should be addressed.

concerns.concern: The authors attribute Raman differences from prior reports to sample dependence, but sample-dependent new modes could equally indicate extrinsic origins such as intergrowths or oxygen defects.
concerns.quote: Sample-dependent new modes would also be consistent with extrinsic origins (intergrowths, oxygen defects)

concerns.concern: There is no confirmation, for example by resistivity or susceptibility on the same batch, that these specific crystals undergo a DW transition at ambient pressure.
concerns.quote: Please confirm that a DW transition occurs in these specific crystals at ambient pressure (resistivity or susceptibility on the same batch).

concerns.concern: The phase diagram has essentially four experimental points, and the claimed linear suppression between 0 and ~10 GPa has no data. The line should be labeled as an interpolation or intermediate points added.
concerns.quote: The "linear suppression" between 0 and ~10 GPa spans 300–1030 K with no data.

concerns.concern: Transition points are determined from qualitative changes in peak shape. They should be quantified with a measurable quantity, with the extrapolation and uncertainties shown.
concerns.quote: The transition is determined from qualitative changes in peak shape. Please quantify it

concerns.concern: The proposed low-temperature Pc/P2₁ phases are polar, so the claim should be tested with second-harmonic generation and by comparing the new Raman modes with published IR phonon frequencies.
concerns.quote: Second-harmonic generation would directly probe loss of inversion.

concerns.concern: The decisive Bmab versus B2₁/a refinement comparison (R-values, parameters, twin fractions, reflection counts at each P–T point) is only in the SI and should be in the main text.
concerns.quote: The decisive comparison (R-values, numbers of parameters, twin fractions, number of unique and observed reflections, Bmab vs. B2₁/a at each P–T point) should be moved

concerns.concern: Given the narrow margin, the Raman fitting procedure, counting criteria and full mode list with confidence levels should be summarized in the main text rather than the SI.
concerns.quote: the fitting procedure, criteria and the full mode list (with confidence levels) are central and should be summarized in the main text.

concerns.concern: The pressure path (compression or decompression, isothermal or isobaric) and whether hysteresis was checked are not specified, which matters given the suggested first-order character.
concerns.quote: Please specify the pressure path (compression vs. decompression, isothermal vs. isobaric) and whether hysteresis was checked.

concerns.concern: The 80 K tilt-angle data stop at ~9 GPa while the transition is placed at ~13 GPa; data closer to the boundary are needed.
concerns.quote: the 80 K tilt angle is shown only up to ~9 GPa, while T_S(80 K) is placed at ~13 GPa.

concerns.concern: The reciprocal-space regions searched for DW satellites, and whether they include the reported propagation vectors, are not specified.
concerns.quote: Specify the reciprocal-space regions searched and whether they include the reported propagation vectors.

concerns.concern: Lattice parameters versus temperature through the DW transition (including b-axis negative thermal expansion) should be shown, since only 230 and 80 K refinements are mentioned.
concerns.quote: Lattice parameters versus T through T_DW from the DESY data would be valuable

concerns.concern: The "most pessimistic" ~3 GPa uncertainty in comparing DFT with experiment makes the claimed quantitative agreement in the phase diagram less meaningful.
concerns.quote: The "most pessimistic" ΔP ≈ 3 GPa estimate, however, makes the quantitative agreement in Fig. 1 less meaningful than implied.

concerns.concern: The claim that the relaxation is free to span all four structures holds only for supergroups compatible with that cell. It does not cover other tilt patterns such as Pccn- or P4₂/ncm-type.
concerns.quote: true only for supergroups of P2₁/c compatible with that cell, not for other tilt patterns (e.g. Pccn- or P4₂/ncm-type).

concerns.concern: The onset temperature of the new Raman modes is given inconsistently (120–150 K, ~130 K, below ~120 K).
concerns.quote: The new modes are said to appear between 120 and 150 K, at ~130 K, and below ~120 K in different places.

concerns.concern: The claim that the monoclinic phase is independent of growth method (flux or floating zone) is untested, since only flux-grown crystals were studied.
concerns.quote: is not tested here, since only flux-grown crystals were studied.

concerns.concern: The bulk-modulus fits show a large temperature dependence (155 vs 182–185 GPa). It is unclear whether both phases were fitted together and whether K′ was fixed or refined.
concerns.quote: K₀ = 155 GPa at 300 K versus 182–185 GPa at 80/20 K is a large (~18%) temperature dependence.

concerns.concern: Ref. [37] may be misattributed as identifying Bmab, since Zhang et al. reported monoclinic P2₁/a.
concerns.quote: To my knowledge, Zhang et al. (PRMaterials 2020) reported monoclinic P2₁/a for La₄Ni₃O₁₀. Please check this attribution.

concerns.concern: The group–subgroup chain from I4/mmm to P2₁/c should be stated with indices and transformation matrices.
concerns.quote: The chain "P2₁/c ⊂ Bmab ⊂ Fmmm ⊂ I4/mmm" should be stated with indices and transformation matrices.

concerns.concern: Different sections use inconsistent cell-setting conventions. A single table of transformation matrices between the settings is requested.
concerns.quote: A single table of transformation matrices between P2₁/c, B2₁/a, Bmab, F4/mmm and I4/mmm in the main text would greatly help readers.

concerns.concern: The statement that the octahedra are "perfect" at 15 GPa contradicts the described strong octahedral distortion; "untilted" is presumably meant.
concerns.quote: "At 15 GPa, the octahedra is perfect" contradicts the preceding description of strongly distorted octahedra

concerns.concern: The exposure and contrast scaling of each Fig. 2 panel should be specified, since weak-reflection visibility depends on them.
concerns.quote: Specify exposure and contrast scaling for each panel. Weak-reflection visibility in panel (c) depends heavily on these.

concerns.concern: The reason for choosing the particular reflections shown in Fig. 2 is not explained.
concerns.quote: Explain why reflections like 4 6 0, 6 4 0 and −2 6 0 were chosen.

concerns.concern: Fig. 5's triple y-axis is hard to read. Separate panels and log-log plots of order parameter versus (P_c − P) are suggested to support the scaling claims.
concerns.quote: The triple y-axis with the middle axis placed at P_c is hard to read.

concerns.concern: The actual sample temperature calibration in the Raman measurements should be stated, given the 2 K base versus 26 K effective temperature.
concerns.quote: State the actual sample temperature calibration (e.g. Stokes/anti-Stokes) given the 2 K base temperature versus 26 K effective.

concerns.concern: There are numerous typos, garbled sentences and misused wording, and the manuscript needs careful language editing.
concerns.quote: The manuscript would benefit from careful language editing.

concerns.concern: The "horizon" metaphor in the title is opaque; a more descriptive title is suggested.
concerns.quote: The title metaphor ("horizon") is somewhat opaque. A more descriptive title would help discoverability.
